discovery.what_it_does.subnet: Each address gets a ping, a few TCP ports, SNMP with the credentials above, and over HTTPS a look for Redfish (iLO, iDRAC) and vSphere (ESXi, vCenter). It runs from the worker; let your network team know before scanning.
discovery.what_it_does.vcenter: Reads clusters, hosts and VMs through the vCenter API (read-only is enough). VM addresses come from VMware Tools; each VM depends on its host.

{link}

The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
notify.mail.test.subject: Fudo test email
notify.mail.test.text:

oncall.add_person: Add a person to the rotation…
oncall.enabled: Page people for this team's incidents
oncall.escalation_hint: For incidents of items this team owns. Minutes count from when the incident opened; paging stops as soon as someone acknowledges it. Each person is reached through their own notification steps.
oncall.first_shift_hint: The first person in the list is on call from this day; the rest follow in turn.
oncall.nobody: Nobody is on call: set up and enable the rotation below.
oncall.overrides_hint: Someone else covers a period, for example a swap, a holiday or sick leave. Overrides win over the rotation.
oncall.target.next: The next person in the rotation
oncall.title: On-call
oncall.unreachable: No personal notification steps yet: {names}. They will be emailed at their sign-in address; ask them to add contact methods in their profile.
overview.ask_an_administrator_for_access: Ask an administrator for access to a tenant.
overview.create_a_tenant_for_each_busine: Create a tenant for each business unit under Administration › Tenants, then invite users.
overview.no_applications_yet_group_your_: No applications yet. Group your monitors into applications to see availability and SLA here.
overview.rls_off: NOT enforced: database user bypasses row-level security
pm.col.title: Title
pm.hidden_children: Linked incidents in other tenants, not shown: {n}
pm.no_impact: No other incidents were linked to this one.
pm.no_lessons: No resolution or actions were recorded. Add notes to the incident to keep what was learned.
pm.title: Post-incident report · {key}
profile.code_resent: A new code is on its way.
profile.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code. Enter it here to confirm this contact method.
profile.confirm_remove_contact: Remove this contact method? Notification steps that use it are removed too.
profile.contacts_lead: How Fudo reaches you personally, for example when you are on call. Each one is confirmed with a code first.
profile.email_hint: To change your email address, ask an administrator.
profile.label: Name (optional)
profile.new_codes_lead: Confirm your password to get 10 new recovery codes. The old ones stop working.
profile.new_device_lead: Confirm your password, then scan a new code with the authenticator app on your new phone. Your current phone keeps working until you confirm.
profile.old_device_hint: After confirming, codes from your old phone no longer work and your other sessions are signed out.
profile.password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
profile.password_hint: At least 12 characters. Your other sessions are signed out.
profile.scan_new: Scan this code with the authenticator app on your new phone, or enter the key by hand.
profile.steps_lead: When you are on call, Fudo follows these steps until the incident is acknowledged: for example email at once, Telegram after 5 minutes.
profile.steps_need_contact: Add and verify a contact method first.
profile.teams_how: In Teams, open Workflows, choose the template “Post to a chat when a webhook request is received”, post to your chat with Workflows, and paste the address it shows here.
profile.telegram_how: In Telegram, start a chat with {bot} and send it a message. Then find your chat ID, for example with @userinfobot, and enter it here.
profile.telegram_missing: Telegram is available once an administrator connects a Telegram bot in Settings.
profile.title: Profile
report.businessHours: Business hours: {days} {start}–{end} ({tz}). Planned maintenance does not count against availability.
report.col.title: Title
report.mail.subject: [Fudo] {scope}: {label}
report.noBusinessHours: Planned maintenance does not count against availability.
reports.also_report_availability_during_: Also report availability during business hours
reports.language_hint: Language of the PDF and the email. The organization default is set by a superadmin under Settings.
reports.no_schedules_reports_are_emailed: No schedules. Reports are emailed as PDF and CSV after each week or month, using the SMTP server from Settings.
retention.hint.auditDays: Sign-ins and changes. Check your compliance rules before shortening it.
retention.hint.checkResultsDays: Every single check: the largest data. Detailed charts of recent days.
retention.hint.dailyDays: Response-time charts of 90 days and longer.
retention.hint.deliveriesDays: Each sent notification and on-call message.
retention.hint.incidentsDays: With their timeline, notes and notifications. Older resolutions no longer appear as similar past incidents.
retention.hint.maintenanceDays: Past windows, including those of recurring maintenance.
retention.hint.statusHistoryDays: Availability, reports and status pages (at least 120 days). The last change before the cutoff is always kept.
retention.hint.trapsDays: Every trap received, with its fields. Open problems of trap monitors are kept until they clear.
retention.lead: How long Fudo keeps each kind of data. Together it now takes {size}. Old data is removed every hour, a little at a time.
retention.title: Data retention
settings.default_language_hint: For notifications, emails and scheduled reports. It does not change the interface: each person chooses that under Preferences.
settings.notify_language_lead: Default language of notifications and scheduled reports. Each channel can use its own; emails to a person use that person's language.
settings.preferences_lead: Your own settings; they follow you to any browser you sign in with.
settings.theme_hint: More themes can be added by the administrator (themes folder).
settings.theme_system_hint: Light or Dark, following your operating system
setupwizard.create_the_first_administrat: Create the first administrator. This account can manage every tenant and all settings.
setupwizard.email_is_used_for_invitation: Email is used for invitations, alerts and scheduled reports. You can also configure it later in Settings.
setupwizard.setup_is_complete_you_are_si: Setup is complete. You are signed in as the administrator.
status_page.no_access: You do not have access to this status page.
status_page.not_found: This status page does not exist.
status_page.unavailable: The status page cannot be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.
status_pages.confirm_delete: Delete the status page “{title}”? Its address stops working.
status_pages.internal_hint: Internal: signed-in users with access to this tenant. Incident titles and maintenance names are shown too.
status_pages.labels_hint: The display name is what the page shows instead of the internal name. Items with the same group are shown together.
status_pages.lead: Show the status of chosen applications and infrastructure on a page of its own: public for customers and colleagues without an account, or internal for signed-in users.
status_pages.public_hint: Public: anyone with the link, without signing in. Only the names you set below are shown.
status_pages.show_maintenance: Maintenance (running and in the next 7 days)
status_pages.title: Title
table.loaded_only: Sorting and filtering apply to the events loaded so far ({count}).
teams.confirm_delete: Delete the team “{name}”? Items it owns keep working, without an owner.
teams.lead: Group the people responsible for applications and infrastructure. A team owns applications or assets; its incidents show the team and its leads, and on-call rotations build on teams.
teams.members_hint: Only people with access to this tenant (or to the global infrastructure, for global teams) can be members.
teams.title: Teams
telegram.confirm_remove: Remove the Telegram bot? People's Telegram contact methods stop working.
telegram.lead: Lets people receive on-call messages in a chat with your organisation's bot. Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste its token.
telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.token_hint: Stored encrypted. Fudo checks it with Telegram when you save.
temperature.lead: The inlet temperature of every server, measured by its iLO or other BMC: the air in front of its rack. Tag the monitors room:<name> and rack:<name> to group them.
temperature.no_room_hint: Add a room:<name> tag to these monitors to see them per room and to alert on the whole room.
temperature.none: No temperature sensors yet. Add the iLOs (or other Redfish BMCs) of your servers with Add sensors.
temperature.title: Temperature
theme.dark.description: Graphite surfaces, easy on the eyes in a dark control room.
theme.dark.name: Dark
theme.light.description: Warm paper tones with a dark sidebar (the original Fudo look).
theme.light.name: Light
theme.monokai.name: Monokai
time.days_ago: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago
topology.drag_to_pan_scroll_to_zoom_hove: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · hover to trace dependencies · click to open
topology.no_problems_everything_on_the_m: No problems: everything on the map is up.
topology.no_shared_assets_yet_add_assets: No shared assets yet. Add assets and dependencies to see the map.
topology.nothing_to_draw_yet_add_applica: Nothing to draw yet. Add applications, assets and dependencies.
traps.clear_all_confirm: Clear all open traps of this monitor? The next matching trap opens a problem again.
traps.clear_hint: Clearing ends a problem now; the next matching trap opens it again.
traps.lead: Point your devices' SNMP traps (v1 or v2c) at this server, UDP port {port}. Each trap goes to the trap monitors whose senders include its device.
traps.limit_note: The newest 500 traps are shown. Use the filter or open a monitor for its own traps.
traps.none: No traps received in this scope yet.
traps.none_unclaimed: Every trap went to a monitor.
traps.test_hint: Send a trap from the device (or with snmptrap) and watch it arrive under Traps.
traps.title: Traps

ui.down_and_impacted_time_counts_against: Down and impacted time counts against availability; planned maintenance and time before the first check do not.
ui.fudo_distributed_application_monitori: Fudo: distributed application monitoring and incident management
ui.i_have_saved_my_recovery_codes: I have saved my recovery codes
ui.no_results_in_the_last_24_hours_yet: No results in the last 24 hours yet.
ui.no_results_in_this_range_yet: No results in this range yet.
ui.nothing_to_change_everything_in_the_f: Nothing to change: everything in the file already matches.
ui.qr_code_for_your_authenticator_app: QR code for your authenticator app
ui.recovery_file:
Fudo recovery codes
Each code works once.
ui.response_time_over_the_last_24_hours: Response time over the last 24 hours
ui.smtp_allow_untrusted_hint: For a local SMTP server with a self-signed or internal certificate. The connection stays encrypted, but the server's identity is not verified.
ui.store_these_codes_somewhere_safe_each: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
ui.two_factor_authentication_is_required: Two-factor authentication is required for every account. Scan the code with an authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, 1Password, …).
ui.use_tls_from_the_start_usually_port_4: Use TLS from the start (usually port 465)
